wiki.title: Nanette Barragán
wiki.extract: Nanette Díaz Barragán ( nə-NET BARR-ə-gən; born September 15, 1976) is an American politician and attorney serving as the U.S. representative for California's 44th congressional district since 2017. A member of the Democratic Party, she previously served as a Hermosa Beach city councilmember from 2013 to 2015.
